title: The Expositor's Bible
author: Multiple Authors, ed. W. Robertson Nicoll
tradition_notes: Multi-author series representing the breadth of British evangelical scholarship, c. 1887–1905. Contributors span Presbyterian (Free Church of Scotland, Church of Scotland), Anglican, Baptist, Congregationalist, and Methodist traditions. Broadly Protestant and evangelical in orientation.
source_edition: Christian Classics Ethereal Library digital edition (various dates)
